# React Hotkeys Hook Documentation

> Complete documentation for react-hotkeys-hook - A React hook for handling keyboard shortcuts in a declarative way.

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [Quick Start](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/intro.md): Get up and running with keyboard shortcuts in under a minute.
- [Installation](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/installation.md): Install the package using your preferred package manager:
- [Basic Usage](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/useHotkeys/basic-usage.md): The `useHotkeys` hook lets you listen to keyboard shortcuts declaratively and run a callback when the user presses the specified key combination.
- [Disable/Enable Hotkeys](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/useHotkeys/disable-hotkeys.md): So far we have covered registering hotkeys, scoping them to components, and preventing stale state. But hotkeys are active by default. Sometimes yo...
- [Keyboard Layouts](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/useHotkeys/ignore-layouts.md): Keyboard shortcuts behave differently depending on the user's keyboard layout. By default, `react-hotkeys-hook` listens to the physical key code — ...
- [Scoping Hotkeys](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/useHotkeys/scoping-hotkeys.md): In the previous section we used two keystrokes in two different examples (`ctrl+shift+a+c` and `shift+c`).
- [Callback Dependencies](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/useHotkeys/setting-callback-dependencies.md): The callback you pass to `useHotkeys` is memoized automatically inside the hook to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
- [Advanced Usage](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/advanced-usage.md): It can be hard to remember whether the left arrow key is called `ArrowLeft` or `LeftArrow`. The `ts-key-enum` library provides TypeScript enums for...
- [Grouping Hotkeys together](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/hotkeys-provider.md): `HotkeysProvider` lets you group hotkeys into named scopes. This is useful when you want to disable or enable a whole group of hotkeys at once — fo...
- [isHotkeyPressed](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/is-hotkey-pressed.md): `isHotkeyPressed` lets you check whether a specific key or key combination is currently being held down. This is useful when you need to know modif...
- [Using TypeScript](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/typescript.md): :::tip Works out of the box!
- [useRecordHotkeys](https://johannesklauss.github.io/docs/documentation/use-record-hotkeys.md): `useRecordHotkeys` lets you capture whatever keys the user presses. This is useful for building custom keyboard shortcut settings — for example, le...
